title: After a batch merges, each handed-in lane PR that conflicts with the new main gets one main merge and a review of the resolved hunks only
why: Coordinator 14:59 CST Nov 12: batch 104 (#2814) left #2733, #2737, #2770, #2875, #2920 and #2748, #2833, #2913 in conflict with main; each needed the same pick (merge main in, fresh review of the resolved hunks as a fix check).
note: Write the route in skill ci-hygiene step 8 (Batch lanes): at a batch merge, the runner lists handed-in PRs that now conflict with main; each lane merges main once (no rebase, no force push) and a fresh reviewer reads only the resolved hunks, recorded as a fix check chained to the prior record; a refused chain means a full review. Then the per-PR coordinator pick is not needed. Relates to lane-lint-batch-pr-conflicts and record-before-fix-push. Lane started 15:02 CST Nov 12 (coordinator; no open PR names the step; kin #2326 cited). Lane 15:29 CST Nov 12: PR #2969 (head c7adf46c3) handed in. Clashes for the coordinator: (1) record pr-review-record lines 76 and 82 call for a full review after a conflicted merge, but merge.py:5438 accepts a fix verifier, which the step wants; the paragraph follows the tool. (2) agents/reviewer.md:76 has a post-merge fix verifier read `git diff origin/main...<head>`, the whole lane diff; the route needs a per-parent read. Follow-up: a one-line edit to reviewer.md. Coordinator 15:49 CST Nov 12: owner item 651 conflict-merge-hunk-check (a: a review of only the resolved lines carries a conflicted main merge; b: full review, per decision pr-review-record, owner Nov 10 14:07 CST). Runner 10 holds any conflicted-merge head with only a hunk review meanwhile. Coordinator 16:06 CST Nov 12: line 76 vs line 82 clash in decision pr-review-record filed as step review-record-merge-main-line (one fix verifier in both cases; R1 settles it); cite it on #2969 step 8.
